priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Preserve listener removal in the returned cleanup
findings.body: Every attach call registers a message listener, but invoking the returned cleanup no longer removes it. Consumers that detach or reattach will continue receiving messages through stale handlers, potentially causing duplicate processing and unbounded listener retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 58b2d0d0107249ae1fb51363d66dc8b8bf7e6e38, src/socket.ts:2 still registers the handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed cleanup at line 3 is `return () => {};`; therefore invoking cleanup cannot unregister the listener.
